evidence.note: Dated news report of GitHub's April 27 announcement: $30 and $70 monthly credits for Business and Enterprise in June, July and August. This is the announced plan, not proof it ran.
The same report confirms the $19 Business seat price is unchanged. The next paragraph gives $39 for Enterprise.

reviews.rationale: The window closed on 2026-08-31. The evidence shows Business at $19 with 3,000 credits ($30) and Enterprise at $39 with 7,000 credits ($70), pooled, from June through August 2026. That matches his figures exactly. No counterevidence was found. Limitation: the in-period confirmation rests on a secondary summary, because the GitHub blog could not be read.
